Author: Serpens66
Name: Troop Movement Fix 3
Description: Keeps Improved Spearmen synchronized with slower mixed-group members and maps Ctrl+move to Vanilla free-unit-speeds movement.

Changes: Keep ordinary movement commands and all selection/tribe rebuilding completely Vanilla.
Limit Improved Spearmen to the slowest normal maximum speed and matching cadence in mixed DefaultInSync groups.
Use Vanilla freeUnitSpeeds for Ctrl+move so every unit uses its own Vanilla maximum speed.
Deliberately accept Vanilla speed changes caused by later selection or tribe changes.
